programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic
programme.desc: Forty-one years after the crime, a woman implicates her brother and cousin in the murder of a policeman.

programme.title: Cold Case Files
programme.desc: Easter Sunday of 1992, the body of missing woman Lisa Ziegert is found in a field. The investigation yields hundreds of leads but no true suspect. After more than two decades on ice, the case is revived.

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic
programme.desc: Cops finally close in on a serial killer with the help of the Internet. And a drug trafficker jumps bail goes into the bike shop business and helps pioneer the sport of mountain biking while he's on the lam.

programme.title: Cold Case Files
programme.desc: When 13-year-old Jennifer Bastian is abducted and murdered in August of 1986, residents of Tacoma panic. This is the second young girl killed in five months. Convinced a predator is loose, Police embark on a 32-year inquiry.

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic
programme.desc: This is the story of the hunt for one of the most notorious serial killers in American history--the BTK killer. After committing at least seven brutal murders he vanished for over 25 years before sending clues of his crimes to the media in 2004.

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic
programme.sub-title: Diary Of A Serial Arsonist/The Lost Clue
programme.desc: A highly-regarded California arson investigator is suspected of setting a series of fires, and in Texas, a man is convicted of raping and murdering his 68-year-old neighbor.

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic
programme.desc: A murderer's saliva, found on envelopes, helps seal his doom 37 years after his first killing. And Colorado police crack a cold case 24 years later when they take a DNA sample from the victim's son that proves that his father murdered his mother.

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic
programme.desc: A detective vows not to shave until he solves the murder of a young Oregon woman. It takes three years and a string of Mexican Mafia informants to crack the case and allow the dedicated detective to shave his beard.

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic
programme.desc: A dry cleaning tag inside a sweatshirt left at a crime scene helps police track down a serial killer and rapist who had been eluding them for years.

programme.title: Cold Case Files
programme.desc: In 1984, a 15-year-old girl is found murdered in her grandparents' home. For decades, a stalled investigation only fuels the town rumor mill, pointing an accusing finger at her 13-year-old sister.

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic
programme.desc: We follow Det. Vince Velazquez of Atlanta and Capt. Russell Popham of East Point, Ga., as they work to solve the 1995 rape and murder of 14-year-old Nacole Smith, one of Atlanta's most notorious unsolved crimes.

programme.title: Cold Case Files
programme.desc: One family faces two unsolved murders of their loved ones. It takes thirteen years for detectives to uncover the one missing clue that can lead them to the killer: the hidden crime scene.

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic
programme.desc: In this special 100th edition of Cold Case Files, we look at the biggest serial murder case in U.S. history; hunt for the Green River Killer. Dave Reichert, the detective who made finding the killer his obsession, walks us through the case.

programme.title: Cold Case Files
programme.desc: The body of Lori Nesson is found in a ditch in 1974, yet her death is not ruled a homicide. After four decades, the cause of death is changed to homicide, and the search begins for a killer.

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic
programme.desc: Our cameras follow Detective Manny Reyes as he investigates the 1990 murder of a Fort Worth, Texas woman. Reyes talks to the woman's two sons, who believe that her husband, Bobby, was the murderer.

programme.title: Cold Case Files
programme.desc: In late 1983, the bodies of five people abducted from a local fast food restaurant are found brutally murdered. The main suspect is long believed to be a well-connected local man, until new evidence reveals the true killers.

programme.title: Cold Case Files
programme.desc: In the 1980s, a suspected serial killer preyed on women in small towns located on the banks of the Mississippi River until the murders abruptly ceased and went unsolved.

programme.title: Cold Case Files
programme.desc: When 18-year-old Shannon Siders' body is found in the woods, everyone in the small town of Newaygo, Michigan, becomes a suspect--but no one is convicted of the crime.

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic

programme.title: CSI: New York en español: ¡Déjenme salir! (S8 Ep6)
programme.desc: El equipo de CSI investiga cuando una broma de fraternidad en el Día de Brujas sale mal y un maestro de ceremonias es dado por muerto en una tumba abierta.

programme.title: CSI: New York en español: Juego siniestro (S8 Ep7)
programme.desc: El equipo de CSI investiga cuando la noticia de una fiesta en una escuela secundaria se vuelve viral, lo que da lugar a una aglomeración, un porche colapsado y la muerte de una adolescente.

programme.title: CSI: New York en español: Intercepción (S8 Ep8)
programme.desc: Mientras el equipo de CSI de Nueva York investiga el asesinato de un juez, Jo se encuentra cara a cara con un criminal de su pasado.

programme.title: CSI: New York en español: 48 horas antes (S8 Ep9)
programme.desc: Cuando un testigo importante aparece muerto, Jo se ve envuelta en la peligrosa investigación del presunto violador que liberaron cuando ella trabajaba en Washington D.C.

programme.title: CSI: New York en español: Sin rastro alguno (S8 Ep10)
programme.desc: Un cuerpo carbonizado se convierte en un desastre para el equipo de CSI cuando comienza a parecer que un luchador de artes marciales mixtas ha sido asesinado por su acosador.

programme.title: CSI: New York en español: ¿Quién está ahí? (S8 E11)
programme.desc: Una investigación de violación de domicilio se vuelve más complicada cuando la familia de la víctima resulta ser menos perfecta de lo que parecía originalmente.

programme.title: CSI: New York en español: Brooklyn hasta la muerte (S8 E12)
programme.desc: Un juego de rol se vuelve letal cuando un jugador es víctima de un asesino auténtico y el otro es secuestrado para pedir un rescate.

programme.title: CSI: New York en español: El efecto dominó (S8 Ep13)
programme.desc: Cuando el equipo de CSI investiga dos muertes aparentemente sin relación, sus rastros separados de evidencias conducen a una conclusión que sorprendentemente las vincula.

programme.title: CSI: New York en español: Fin del juego (S8 Ep14)
programme.desc: El equipo de CSI se encuentra inmerso en el mundo de los videojuegos competitivos cuando descubre que un asesinato puede estar relacionado con un torneo de altas apuestas.

programme.title: CSI: New York en español: Caso cerrado (S8 Ep15)
programme.desc: Asesinan a un técnico de laboratorio en un caso que se parece a otro sin resolver de la década de 1950, el equipo de CSI vislumbra lo que sucede en las sombras del laboratorio.

programme.title: CSI: New York en español: Salud (S8 Ep16)
programme.desc: Una ola de brutalidad amenaza a una pequeña comunidad de la ciudad de Nueva York cuando encuentran un cuerpo descuartizado y estratégicamente abandonado en cuatro esquinas.

programme.desc: Horatio y el equipo investigan la muerte de una estrella de cine mientras se encontraba en un centro de rehabilitación de celebridades y estaba a punto de exponer algunos secretos dañinos.

programme.title: CSI: Miami en español
programme.desc: Un divorcio desagradable empeora aún más cuando la amante del marido aparece muerta y, a medida que aumenta el cantidad de muertos, Horatio y el equipo de CSI investigan.

programme.title: CSI: Miami en español

programme.title: CSI: Miami en español

programme.title: CSI: Miami en español

programme.title: CSI: Miami en español

programme.title: CSI: Miami en español

programme.title: CSI: Miami en español

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro
programme.desc: Nuestros héroes pasan por una aldea de montaña a tiempo para la migración anual de Chinchou. Los aldeanos siempre envían entrenadores para proteger a los Chinchou en su viaje, pero ¿bastarán para detener al Equipo Rocket?

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro
programme.desc: Cuando el hogar de la familia de un entrenador es amenazado por los Corsola que viven cerca, Ash y sus amigos deben rescatarlos... ¡Y quizás Misty al fin pueda atrapar al Corsola que ha estado buscando!

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro
programme.desc: Después de que nuestros héroes pierden un ferry, conocen a un buzo, quien les ofrece llevarlos a la siguiente isla... ¡Pero pronto se distraen con los cuentos del tesoro a bordo de un barco hundido!

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro
programme.desc: Cuando no están compitiendo en la Copa Remolino, Ash y Misty tratan de ayudar a un joven entrenador cuyo Octillery ha sido rechazado por sus amigos Remoraid tras su evolución.

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro
programme.desc: Luego de ganar las rondas preliminares, Ash y Misty enfrentan a oponentes formidables en la Copa Remolino. ¡Mientras tanto, el trío del Equipo Rocket tiene el objetivo de robar el premio del torneo!

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro
programme.desc: Es la segunda ronda de la Copa Remolino, ¡y Ash y Misty deben enfrentarse uno al otro! ¿Quién saldrá victorioso? ¿Y el plan del Equipo Rocket para distraer a la policía tendrá éxito?

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro
programme.desc: Nuestros héroes tienen el deber de proteger una aldea de los merodeadores que amenazan con huir con los Diglett que viven ahí. Y gracias a una deliciosa cena, el Equipo Rocket también se ofrece a ayudar.

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro
programme.sub-title: El robo de las alas plateadas
programme.desc: Nuestros héroes conocen a un joyero que les cuenta la leyenda de la cuarta isla Remolino… ¡Y pronto se encuentra envuelto en un plan del Equipo Rocket!

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro
programme.desc: Mientras dos grupos de villanos del Equipo Rocket salen a capturar al Pokémon legendario Lugia, Ash encuentra a su viejo amigo Richie y a su compañero, ¡un Pikachu llamado Sparky!

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro
programme.desc: El pequeño Lugia llamado Silver ha caído en las manos de Butch y Cassidy del Equipo Rocket, y con la ayuda de Richie, Ash debe ganar la confianza del Lugia adulto antes de caer en la misma trampa.

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro
programme.desc: Mientras Ash trata de rescatar a dos Lugia del Equipo Rocket, ¡Ash y sus amigos son hechos prisioneros! Ahora, deben hallar una forma de escapar... ¡Y de liberar también a los Pokémon capturados!

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro
programme.desc: Ash y sus amigos van en un avión hacia Ciudad Olivine cuando quedan atrapados en una terrible tormenta que también atrapa al globo del Equipo Rocket. Tendrán que trabajar juntos para aterrizar a salvo... ¿Pero podrán hacerlo?

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro
programme.desc: Después de varias interrupciones, incluyendo otro Plan del Equipo Rocket, la batalla de Ash contra Jasmine en el Gimnasio Olivine finalmente está en marcha.

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro
programme.desc: Cuando los Pokémon del laboratorio del profesor Oak en Kanto no se llevan bien, el profesor le pide a Ash que mande a su Bulbasaur al laboratorio para que lo ayude a mantener la paz.

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro
programme.desc: En Ciudad Ecruteak, nuestros héroes encuentran a su amiga Sakura y su recién evolucionado Espeon. Sakura y sus hermanas se preparan para una competencia de baile, pero el Equipo Rocket acecha, tratando de robar a sus Pokémon…

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro
programme.desc: Cuando nuestros héroes investigan un repentino repique de campanas, descubren que las Campanas de Cristal, que solo repican cuando el Pokémon legendario Ho-Oh regresa, no están. El investigador Eusine parece saber algo...

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro
programme.desc: Cuando Ash encuentra a su viejo rival Gary preparándose para inscribir a su Arcanine en una carrera, decide competir también. Pero primero, tendrá que alejar al Equipo Rocket de la Guardería Pokémon.

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro
programme.desc: Cuando los huevos Pokémon de Ash desaparecen, nuestros héroes piden la ayuda de una desafortunada Oficial Jenny. Pronto se dan cuenta de que, si quieren recuperar el huevo, tendrán que buscarlo ellos mismos.

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro
programme.desc: El momento por fin ha llegado: ¡Un Phanpy ha salido del Huevo Pokémon de Ash! El pequeño Pokémon está lleno de energía y pronto sale volando... ¡Con nuestros héroes y el Equipo Rocket detrás!

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro
programme.desc: Jessie, James y Meowth toman un tiempo para lamer sus heridas y soñar con robar a Pikachu para gloria del Equipo Rocket. Tras un encuentro con un explorador del Equipo Rocket, parece que estos sueños estallan ante sus ojos.

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro
programme.desc: Cuando una espesa niebla interrumpe el viaje de nuestros héroes, una niña y su Ninetales los invitan a descansar en una mansión cercana... ¡Donde Brock y su anfitrión inician un romance que podría resultar fantasmal!

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro
programme.desc: Cerca de Mr. Mortar, nuestros héroes encuentran a un entrenador que intenta contener los impulsos de su Tyrogue. Pero cuando el Equipo Rocket se entromete, ¿podrá salvar al problemático Tyrogue de las garras de los villanos?

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro
programme.desc: Nuestros héroes conocen a una chica que cuida a un grupo de Xatu con poderes psíquicos que predicen el futuro de una aldea. Cuando los aldeanos comienzan a dudar de ellos, ¿podrán los Xatu probar la verdad de sus visiones?

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro
programme.desc: Al llegar al Lago Furia, Pikachu y Togepi enferman, y nuestros héroes son atacados por un Gyarados rojo enfurecido. Cuando el Equipo Rocket aparece en escena, las cosas parecen mucho más peligrosas para Ash y sus amigos…

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro
programme.desc: Las cosas se ven mal para nuestros héroes, quienes han sido capturados por el Equipo Rocket en el Lago Furia. Con el destino de los Pokémon del mundo en juego, ¿podrá Ash sobreponerse a la ocasión y salvar el día?

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro
programme.desc: Después de llegar a Pueblo Mahogany, Ash entrena para su próxima batalla de gimnasio. Pero tras ser despreciado por Pryce, el líder de gimnasio, ¿podrá nuestro héroe convencer a su gélido oponente de darle una oportunidad?

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro
programme.desc: Pryce y Ash están a punto de enfrentarse en un frío concurso en el gimnasio del pueblo Mahogany. ¿Podrá Ash mostrar lo que sus Pokémon y él pueden hacer y así ganar su séptima medalla de gimnasio de la región Johto?

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro
programme.desc: Nuestros héroes encuentran grupos de batalla de Bellossom y Vileplume, recientemente evolucionados. Como cada grupo lucha cada vez con mayor número e intensidad, ¿podrán nuestros héroes ponerle fin a la disputa?

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Enter the Desert Pirates! The Men Who Live Freely!
programme.desc: The Straw Hats cross paths with the Barbar Sand Pirates, and Ace runs into big trouble when he gets separated from the group.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: False Fortitude! Camu, Rebel Soldier at Heart!
programme.desc: Princess Vivi devises a plan to test the hearts of a gang of so-called rebels. They talk a good game, but will their bite measure up to their bark?

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Rebel Warrior Koza! The Dream vowed to Vivi!
programme.desc: The Straw Hats continue their journey to Yuba, where a bittersweet reunion with a childhood friend awaits Princess Vivi.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Showdown in a Heat Haze! Ace vs. the Gallant Scorpion!
programme.desc: Fire Fist Ace is hired by two young boys to hunt down and capture a lethal bounty hunter known only as the Scorpion.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Ruins and Lost Ways! Vivi, Her Friends and the Country's Form!
programme.desc: Chopper, Zoro, and Luffy get separated from the others. When the heat makes Luffy act even stranger than usual, his friends wonder if they joined the right pirate gang.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Spiders Caf? at 8 o'Clock! The Enemy Leaders Gather!
programme.desc: The assassins of Baroque Works gather at Spider’s Café, and the Straw Hats arrive at Yuba only to find it buried in sand.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Luffy vs. Vivi! The Tearful Vow to Put Friends on the Line
programme.desc: Crocodile reveals himself to the Baroque Works assassins and discloses his dastardly plan for Alabasta. After departing Yuba, Luffy takes a stand that forces Vivi to rethink her mission.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: The Battlefront of Alabasta! Rainbase, the City of Dreams
programme.desc: Vivi takes Luffy’s advice, and the Straw Hats head towards Rainbase for a confrontation with Crocodile. Karoo finally reaches the palace with Vivi’s warning for King Cobra.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: The Trap of Certain Defeat! Storming Raindinners!
programme.desc: Luffy leads a daring – but foolish – raid on Crocodile’s casino. His poor planning lands him behind bars with Captain Smoker – and more importantly, leaves Vivi unprotected.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Operation Utopia Commences! The Swell of Rebellion Stirs!
programme.desc: While the Straw Hats are stuck in the clink, King Cobra addresses the starving people of Nanohana. Will his unbelievable revelation drive his subjects past the brink of rebellion?

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: The Terrifying Banana Gators and Mr. Prince!
programme.desc: A royal imposter has the rebel army hell-bent on bringing Cobra’s reign to a violent end. Meanwhile, Luffy and his mates find themselves in deep trouble and even deeper water.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: The Key to a Great Comeback Escape! The Wax-Wax Ball!
programme.desc: Sanji shows up in the nick of time to make the crocs cough up the key to Luffy’s freedom, but the ravenous reptiles spit up something else instead.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Merciless Mortal Combat! Luffy vs Crocodile
programme.desc: Crocodile snatches Vivi off the back of a giant crab, but Luffy’s not having it. The rubber-man goes toe-to-toe with the sandman in a battle that will end in bloodshed.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Dash For a Miracle! Alabasta Animal Land
programme.desc: Crocodile puts Luffy down for a never-ending dirt nap, and the Straw Hats get a lift from a crabby ally in their race to stop the looming rebellion.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Rebel Army vs. Royal Army! Showdown at Alubarna
programme.desc: Vivi arrives in Alubarna with just enough time to stop the rebellion, but the agents of Baroque Works lurk in every corner, waiting to sabotage her plans for peace.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Alubarna Grieves! The Fierce Captain Karoo
programme.desc: Sanji buys Vivi some time by mixing it up with a foe of many faces. Outside Alubarna’s walls, Chopper and Usopp tangle with Miss Merry Christmas and her slugging sidekick.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Sworn on a Friend's Dream! The Battle of Molehill, Block 4
programme.desc: Usopp finally shows some courage by using a five-ton hammer to play whack-a-mole with Miss Merry Christmas. He may be bluffing, but the distraction lets Chopper zero in on the enemy’s weakness.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Big Opening Day Today! The Copy-Copy Montage
programme.desc: Chopper’s Rumble Ball could be the difference between life and death in the mole ballgame. Elsewhere, Sanji has trouble kicking a pretty enemy, and Vivi proposes something unthinkable.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Transformed into Nami! Bon Clay's Rapid-Fire Ballet Kenpo!
programme.desc: Vivi continues preparations to blow up the palace; Zorro puts his steel to the test against a lethal blade-man; Sanji tries to overcome his inability to kick a foxy lady!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Nami's Cyclone Advisory! Clima Tact Burst!
programme.desc: Things don’t look good for the prettiest Straw Hat. Nami’s about to tangle with a thorny adversary, and the weapon Usopp built her is only good for party tricks!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Secret Passed Down In The Royal Family! The Ancient Weapon Pluton!
programme.desc: Crocodile reveals his sinister motives for attacking Alabasta, and Nami tries to end her duel with Miss Doublefinger by unleashing the Clima Tact’s ultimate weapon: a devastatingly lethal tornado!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Secret Of Powerful Swordplay! Ability To Cut Steel And The Rhythm Things Have!
programme.desc: Zoro hopes to attain a new level of strength when he fights a foe with a body made of blades. The Straw Hat sword-slinger is determined to become a man who can cut steel – or die trying.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: The Battle is Over! Koza Raises the White Flag!
programme.desc: Koza – the leader of the rebel army – finally discovers the evil mastermind behind Alabasta’s drought, but is he too late to prevent further bloodshed?

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Where Vivi's Voice Gets Heard! The Hero Descends!
programme.desc: When Koza is mysteriously shot, the rebellion is reborn, but Vivi’s cries for a cease-fire fall on deaf ears until a long-overdue hero swoops to the rescue!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Sand Croc and Water Luffy!... The Second Round of the Duel!
programme.desc: Luffy finally discovers the secret to knocking out a sandman, but it won’t matter unless Vivi and the rest of the Straw Hats can locate the Baroque Works bomber.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: That Looks Croc-ish!... Luffy, Run to the Royal Tomb!
programme.desc: While his mates search for a bomb, Luffy narrowly survives his second scrape with Crocodile. Across town, Nico Robin strong-arms Cobra into revealing his country’s greatest secret.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: The Nightmare Draws Near!... This is the Sand-Sand Clan's Secret Base
programme.desc: With the walls crumbling down around them, Crocodile attacks Luffy with a poisoned pirate hook. Meanwhile, Vivi draws a bead on the bombers, but can she stop them in time?

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Magnificent Wings! My Name is Pell, Guardian Deity of the Country
programme.desc: The Straw Hats team up to give Vivi one last shot at disarming the bomb that threatens to destroy her city. She succeeds in cutting the fuse, but Crocodile has a backup plan.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: I Will Surpass You! Rain Falls in Alabasta.
programme.desc: Pell’s sacrifice spares his beloved city, but only an act of god can stop the rebellion. With Crocodile’s poison coursing through his body, Luffy musters a final attack against Alabasta’s oppressor.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: A Farewell to Arms! Pirates and Different Ideas of Justice!
programme.desc: Crocodile is defeated, the rain has returned to Alabasta, and Vivi’s people are eager to rebuild their kingdom. As for the Straw Hats, they have a fleet of marines breathing down their necks.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: The Pirates' Banquet And Operation Escape From Alabasta!
programme.desc: Now that the rebellion is over, Vivi must make an important decision about her future. The Straw Hats are ready to hoist the anchor, but an ambiguous villain has stolen the Going Merry!

programme.title: One Piece

programme.desc: Mr. 2 is a man of many faces, but he finally shows his true colors when the marines attack the Straw Hats. Elsewhere, Vivi has a scheme up her sleeve, and it involves Igaram wearing a dress.

programme.desc: Luffy and his crew watch Alabasta fade into the distance, but there’s no time for reminiscing. The marines are in hot pursuit, and there’s a stowaway aboard the Going Merry!

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fills in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.
